# source: amsthm manual (amsthdoc.tex, "Using the amsthm package", for
# amsthm.sty 2020/05/29 v2.20.6): §2 setup and input of theorem elements
# (\newtheorem, \newtheorem*), §3 theorem numbering (the [within] and
# [shared] arguments), §4 theorem styles (\theoremstyle's plain,
# definition and remark; \swapnumbers; \newtheoremstyle), §5 proofs (proof
# and its optional name, \proofname, \qedsymbol, \qed, \qedhere). A
# declaration binds the environment a later \begin uses and moves no ink
# where it stands (inert:binds); what a declared environment sets is
# witnessed on the page by the theorem checks, the proof rows below by
# this index.
pre inert:binds \newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
pre inert:binds \newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
pre inert:binds \newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}\newtheorem{lem}[thm]{Lemma}
pre inert:binds \newtheorem*{thm}{Theorem}
pre inert:binds \theoremstyle{plain}
pre inert:binds \theoremstyle{definition}
pre inert:binds \theoremstyle{remark}
pre refuse:W0301 \swapnumbers
pre refuse:W0301 \newtheoremstyle{note}{3pt}{3pt}{}{}{\itshape}{:}{.5em}{}
body impl \begin{proof}x\end{proof}
body impl \begin{proof}[Sketch]x\end{proof}
body impl \renewcommand{\proofname}{Argument}\begin{proof}x\end{proof}
body impl \renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{QED}\begin{proof}x\end{proof}
body impl \begin{proof}x\[ y \qedhere \]\end{proof}
body refuse:W0301 x\qed
